info.title: Veltrix Panel Public API
info.description:
Public endpoints for account sales, reseller sales, renewal, free tests, credential recovery, and CheckUser.
Auth: PWA session cookie (bootstrap) or `X-Public-Api-Token` header for server integrations.

servers.description: Panel API base (prepend your licensed domain)

PaymentIdParam.description: Gateway payment ID, internal order_id (ORD_…), wallet preference_id, or numeric db_payment_id

gateway.description: Primary gateway (first in gateways). Includes payer_document and payer_document_rules.

expiration_date.description: Always UTC. Real accounts return the calendar date only (ISO YYYY-MM-DD or common date pattern). Test accounts may include time (ISO YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ or common pattern with H:i:s).

expiration_hours.description: Present only for test accounts (is_test=1). Remaining hours (minimum 1 while still valid; 0 if expired).

payment_id.description: Poll GET /payment/{paymentId}/status with this value. For wallet (`account_money`) it is the internal order_id until Mercado Pago creates a payment.

checkout_url.description: URL to open. Production credentials use init_point; TEST- credentials use sandbox_init_point. Country TLD follows the MP account (.com.ar = Argentina).

provisioning.description: True when payment is approved but the SSH/V2Ray account is still being created. Keep polling.

account.description: Present only after approved provisioning. Contains username/password and/or v2ray_uuid.

reseller.description: Present for approved reseller subscription purchase, reseller credit purchase, or reseller renewal.

credits_balance.description: Current credit balance for a credit reseller.

login_limit.description: Login limit for a subscription reseller.

duration_days.description: Renewal duration; present for reseller renewal.

credits.description: Present for an approved credit purchase for an existing reseller.

reseller_renewal.description: Present only for an approved reseller renewal.

post.description:
Creates checkout for an SSH/V2Ray plan. `payment_method_type` must be a `method_id` from
`GET /public/sales/{slug}/payment-methods` (pix, credit_card, paypal, account_money, oxxo, rapipago, …).

Optional SSH credentials: `username` and `password` (aliases `account_username`/`account_password`, `usuario`/`senha`).
Omit them or send empty strings to keep random generation after payment approval.

This response never includes the account password. After paying, poll
`GET /public/payment/{paymentId}/status` until `status` is `approved` and the `account` object is present.

Wallet (`account_money`): optional `return_url` (HTTPS) is the Mercado Pago “back to site” page.
Query `wallet` + `order_id` are appended. Omit it to return to the panel PWA.

payment_method_type.description: Required. Use an exact method_id returned by this seller's GET payment-methods catalog. IDs vary by active gateway, region, selected methods, and amount; the examples are not an exhaustive list.

customer_cpf.description: Customer document required only when the selected gateway/method rules require it.

identification_type.description: Document type from the selected gateway's payer_document field.

card_token.description: Mercado Pago SDK token; never send raw card number or CVV.

mp_device_session_id.description: Send in production Mercado Pago card checkouts.

username.description: Optional SSH/V2Ray login. Letter case is preserved. Empty or omitted keeps random generation.

password.description: Optional SSH password (SSH/combo plans). Empty or omitted keeps random generation.

return_url.description: Optional. HTTPS page on your site for Mercado Pago Wallet return (aliases success_url, back_url). Query wallet=success|failure|pending and order_id are appended. Omit to keep the panel PWA.

get.description:
Look up by gateway `payment_id`, internal `order_id` (`ORD_…`), wallet
`preference_id`, or numeric `db_payment_id`. Wallet checkout has no Mercado Pago
payment yet — poll with the returned `payment_id` (same as `order_id`).

SSH/V2Ray credentials are returned only when `status` is `approved` and the `account` object is present.
If `provisioning` is `true`, the payment is approved but the account is still being created — keep polling.
Create-payment (`POST /public/sales/{slug}/payment`) never returns credentials.

post.summary: Create a free trial (credentials by email)
post.description:
Creates a test account. Credentials are sent by e-mail only (never in this response).

Optional SSH credentials: `username` and `password` (aliases `account_username`/`account_password`, `usuario`/`senha`).
Omit them or send empty strings to keep random generation.

Username: `^[a-zA-Z0-9]{3,32}$` (letter case preserved). Reserved names (`root`, `admin`, …) are rejected.
Password: 6–64 characters, no control characters. Either field may be sent alone.
Duplicate usernames (existing `users` row or pending payment reservation) return HTTP **409**.

post.summary: Create a free trial (credentials in JSON)
post.description:
Creates a test account and returns credentials in the JSON response.
Accepts **only** `X-Public-Api-Token` (no PWA session).

Optional SSH credentials: `username` and `password` (aliases `account_username`/`account_password`, `usuario`/`senha`).
Same validation and 409 duplicate rules as `POST /public/test/{slug}/create`.

get.description:
Returns the list of servers available for the authenticated token/session user.
- **Resellers (`reseller` / `sub_reseller`)**: Returns active servers belonging to the reseller's assigned category.
- **Admins (`super_admin` / `admin`)**: Returns all servers along with real-time `/onlines` (online user counts) and `/system/resources` (CPU, Memory, Disk usage) metrics.

Returns a Bash installer as `text/plain`. The short-lived, single-use token is generated by an authenticated admin when registering a command-mode server. Run the generated command on the target VPS as root. Do not share or publish the tokenized URL.

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: Short-lived install token from the panel. Treat as a secret.

text/plain.example:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -e
# Generated for one server; includes a redacted one-time token.
# Run only on the intended VPS as root.
...

post.description: Called by the generated VPS installer after the Sentinel API starts. The one-time install token authenticates the callback and is consumed after a successful install. This route does not use `X-Public-Api-Token`.

token.description: One-time token embedded in the generated installer.

value.message: Servidor instalado e vinculado com sucesso
Instalação reportou falha

get.summary: Download manual Sentinel API update script
get.description: Returns the manual Bash update script as `text/plain`. Use it on VPS servers registered with `command` or `shared` installation mode, which do not support panel-managed SSH updates. Execute the script as root on the target server.

text/plain.example:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -e
# Updates the Sentinel API to the latest compatible release.
systemctl restart VeltrixPanel.service
